data.text: Before we head out, how about we each catch 10 tons this month? That’s $10,000 apiece, and the 50 tons left will double back to 100 for next month. It’s the largest total catch we can keep taking month after month without shrinking the lake. My family taught me to leave enough fish for tomorrow, and I want this lake supporting all our families for years. Let’s agree on that equal share and review everyone’s catches together afterward. John, are you on board?
